```yaml
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Target version (without v prefix)'
        required: true
        default: '1.4.0'

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Python 3.9
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install bump2version pylint

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest

      - name: Run pylint
        run: |
          pylint $(git ls-files '*.py')

      - name: Check current version
        id: check_version
        env:
          TARGET_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(jq -r .version custom_components/dreo/manifest.json)
          echo "current_version=$CURRENT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          if [ "$CURRENT_VERSION" != "$TARGET_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "needs_bump=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "needs_bump=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Bump version
        if: steps.check_version.outputs.needs_bump == 'true'
        env:
          TARGET_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: github-actions[bot]
          GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: github-actions[bot]
          GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
        run: |
          bump2version --new-version "$TARGET_VERSION" --allow-dirty --commit --tag --verbose

      - name: Push changes
        if: steps.check_version.outputs.needs_bump == 'true'
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD
          git push --tags

      - name: Zip artifact
        env:
          TARGET_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          zip -r "dreo-${TARGET_VERSION}.zip" custom_components/dreo

      - name: Create release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ inputs.version }}
          name: Release v${{ inputs.version }}
          body: |
            Release notes for v${{ inputs.version }}.
          files: dreo-${{ inputs.version }}.zip
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
